item.title: Police Discover Large Cannabis Factory in Market Harborough

item.title: Big Success For Young Farmers’ Tree Recycling Scheme
item.description: Norton & Gaulby Young Farmers are celebrating the success of their Christmas tree recycling scheme in the Harborough district. They recycled over 560 trees and raised £4,500, which will be split between GEMS Charity, East Midlands Air Ambulance and the Yellow Wellies Foundation. The group would like to thank everyone who supported the scheme.
